function.name: execute
function.arguments: {"command":"python -c 'import pandas as pd; d=pd.read_csv(\"measurements.csv\"); print(d.shape); print(d.isna().sum().to_dict()); print(\"zero widths\",(d.correlation_width==0).sum(),\"monotonic t\",d.time_s.is_monotonic_increasing,\"dt\",d.time_s.diff().dropna().round(8).value_counts().head().to_dict()); print(d.describe().to_string()); print(\"corr\",d[[\"correlation_width\",\"mean_shear_magnitude\"]].corr().iloc[0,1]); d[\"bin\"]=(d.time_s//1).astype(int); print(d.groupby(\"bin\")[[\"correlation_width\",\"width_ste_export\",\"mean_shear_magnitude\"]].agg([\"mean\",\"median\",\"min\",\"max\"]).round(3).to_string())'"}
